description: A contract or schema is part of the inputs, so completion requires contract tests wired to the input REQ IDs.
why_this_matters: A provided API or schema contract is not done when only ordinary unit or integration tests exist.

input.user_prompt:
Build requirements/ECCS-12837/plan/plan.md
Go through it step by step and apply each step acceptance criteria in the agent loop.
input.context: plan.md lists docs/openapi.yaml as a provided contract. Unit and integration tests exist for the REQ IDs, but no *Contract* test references openapi.yaml or cites those REQ IDs. The coverage gate reports contractFailures.
